defects.detail: 'in vadabundo mari, spe salutis posita' (hope of safety abandoned) rendered 'with his hope of safety placed in God' — 'in God' has no counterpart
'quæ nugæ res moueri non possunt' rendered 'such trifles cannot be moved' — obscure clause papered over

reason: Cardano's dream allegory and the Hamilton story are rendered faithfully throughout; adds 'in God' to 'spe salutis posita'; one obscure clause glossed loosely.
Prognosis, the Deut/Jer/Ezek/Sirach citations, Leopold's Latin forecast and colophon all = source; nothing found wrong.

defects.detail: Matt 5:28 quotation 'ἤδη ἐμοίχευσεν αὐτήν' extended to 'has already committed adultery with her in his heart' — 'in his heart' is not in the source
'Πᾶς γὰρ οὐκ ἂν καὶ εὐλόγως τις αἰνῷτο' split into a dangling '"For everyone who..."' plus a separate sentence

reason: Clement's refutation of Cassianus is rendered closely, including the page's opening lines (placed inside the meta); adds 'in his heart' to the Matthew quote; one awkwardly split rhetorical question.

defects.detail: '疑生之豆' (the dou of Yisheng, a named vessel) rendered 'a Dou from the state of Yi'

reason: Gui square / pu round, the similarity to dou and deng, the inscriptions, the reasoning on 鋪 and the list of vessels are all rendered; 疑生 misread as 'state of Yi'.

defects.detail: 'ai fine predo impenduntur' (cum sine pretio, given without price) rendered 'expended with a final intention' with an added note 'the intention of the giver'

'esse propter deum non det spem [speciem] elemosine ... tn dat sibi vltimu complementu' rendered 'one does not give the alms for the sake of God ... he nevertheless gives it to himself as the ultimate complement'
'sic in li. di. xxvj' rendered 'in the fourth book, distinction 26' — 'fourth' not in the source

reason: Scholastic replies on alms and satisfaction are followed closely; 'sine pretio' misread as 'final intention', 'speciem' misread in the fifth reply, and a book number added.

defects.detail: 'πολλὰ μὲν ... χρήματ', ἐξόν μοι λαβεῖν ... οὐ λαβών' (though I could have taken much money, I did not) rendered 'I had many riches ... which I could have taken'
'ἠνώχληκε καὶ παρήγγελκεν' (pestered and canvassed) rendered 'annoyed and summoned'

reason: Against Meidias passage rendered faithfully overall; 'I had many riches' misstates the refused bribe; 'summoned' for canvassing.

defects.detail: garbled 'οὐδὴ μισιφίκος' rendered 'Nor is it a misiphikos: hater of wisdom' with an invented gloss
'θυοπάδου' rendered 'always being sacrificed'; 'ξύλου' in a garbled clause rendered 'dissimilarity of wood'
opening meta supplies a previous-page passage ('love of God ... civic virtues') with a note, not on this page

reason: Heavily garbled Proclus-type Greek rendered word by word, mostly marked <unclear>; the legible sentences (every soul divine, many-headed beast, leonine crowd) are right; several garbled words given confident glosses.

defects.detail: column 4 'ΥΓ','ΡΒ','ΡΚ','ΡΟΑ','ΡΠ' (403, 102, 120, 171, 180) rendered 103, 112, 130, 181, 190 — values regularised to a sequence instead of read
'ΡΖΖ' rendered 177 and 'ΡΜΓ ΚΚ' rendered '143 21'

reason: Headers and most cells transliterate correctly (ΤΝΖ=357, ΡΞ ΝΒ=160 52), but a run of column-1 values loses the hundreds and column 4 is renumbered rather than read.

defects.detail: 'das es ist immer gescheid in Keinem laus' rendered 'perfectly unified in every respect' — loose for an obscure clause
'feuer machen guts silber Zu der das bley' rendered 'make a fire to produce good silver, for which lead is used' — interpretive

reason: The six skills, the bladder and nine-day furnace procedures, and the list of salts are all rendered; two obscure clauses smoothed interpretively.
Aphorisms VIII-XIII on bodily flux and the need to eat and drink = source; nothing found wrong.
Homily on love of God and neighbour rendered sentence for sentence, preserving the source's <unclear> marks and ellipses; nothing found wrong.

defects.detail: 'नीलन्खेभ्यः' (nīlanakhebhyaḥ, blue-nailed) rendered 'To the dark-necked ones'
'पर्यायेभ्यः' (to the series/sections) rendered 'To the rotating ones'
the variant-reading footnotes (१. गायत्र्यै C; ... ८. प्र. RW.) are not rendered

reason: Commentary on the metre mantras and the Āṅgirasa hymn rendered closely; two hymn terms mistranslated; the critical-apparatus footnotes omitted.
Every dated entry 1474-1564 (Charles the Bold, Luther, Loyola, Huss, Ziska) = source; nothing found wrong.

defects.detail: final 'فزدناها' rendered 'We added this' plus '<margin>to the thirty-nine</margin>', which is not in the source
'بما نقص من زوايا الربع' (what is missing at the four corners) rendered 'what was missing from the corners of the fourth'

reason: Completing-the-square construction (halving ten, two 5-cubit strips, 39 plus 25) rendered faithfully; adds a margin completion; 'corners of the fourth' slip.
Founding of the Groupe indépendant, the diamond/magnet test, and the March 1892 evocation set-up = source; nothing found wrong.
School table for Klattau, Prachin, Tabor and Eger districts with all counts and new-school notes = source; nothing found wrong.
